## Become a Tailor

Every Jolly Roger was sewn by someone. Usually someone who complained about it.

Choose Tailor as one of your professions.

**Tasks**

- Choose Tailor

**Rewards**

- Doriki +60, Belly +2,000, Tailor XP +300

Reach Tailor level 5.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Become a Tailor](tailor.md#q-1a7a254e31103982)

- Reach Tailor level 5

**Rewards**

## Journeyman Tailor

Sogeking wore his mask all the way to the top of Enies Lobby. Sew one and take it there.

Reach Tailor level 25 and complete the tasks below.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Apprentice Tailor](tailor.md#q-5cc53a2522c583e5)

**Tasks**

- Reach Tailor level 25
- Sew the Sogeking Mask
- Land on Enies Lobby

**Rewards**

- Doriki +240, Belly +25,000, Tailor XP +3,000

<a id="q-6799d716e2c359f9"></a>

## Expert Tailor

Sew the Fleet Admiral's Hat and carry it to Marineford.

Reach Tailor level 50 and complete the tasks below.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Journeyman Tailor](tailor.md#q-1c0ffcfe468094a3)

**Tasks**

- Reach Tailor level 50
- Sew the Fleet Admiral's Hat
- Land on Marineford

**Rewards**

- Doriki +480, Belly +70,000, Tailor XP +7,000, New World Crate

<a id="q-3bbac23e9c54f287"></a>

## Master Tailor

The Grand Line has one couturier worth the name.

Reach Tailor level 100 and earn the title.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Expert Tailor](tailor.md#q-6799d716e2c359f9)

**Tasks**

- Reach Tailor level 100

**Rewards**

- Doriki +900, Belly +250,000, Legendary Crate
